latest.choice: Pipeline framework builds explicit SEAMS for queue/scheduler/agent integration rather than building the full scheduler now. Concrete design: (1) pipeline/types.py defines ResourceProfile (LLM/CPU/IO tags per ADR-027 §2.2) carried by PipelineStage; PipelineStage.resource_profile + stage_name are queue-compatible with the existing UniversalKBQueue.ProcessingJob contract (stage, contract_version, output_paths). (2) pipeline/orchestrator.py is SYNCHRONOUS by default (ADR-017: queue deferred) but exposes a dispatch_protocol strategy seam: SyncDispatch (default) vs QueueDispatch (adapter over the existing UniversalKBQueue: enqueue/claim/complete), so queue-backed dispatch is a thin adapter — no queue duplication. (3) Resource-aware admission via can_dispatch() checks resource lanes; Phase 2 implements ONLY the simple LLM lane check (ADR-027 §5: MiniMax token_plan before each call) — full 3-lane scheduler deferred to Phase 4. (4) pipeline/primitives.py stages declare their ResourceProfile (CoreEntityExtractor=LLM, StatisticalPreProcessor/EvidenceLinker=CPU). What is NOT built in S02: full 3-lane scheduler (Phase 4), agent FSM runtime (Phase 6, ADR-026), PostgreSQL migration (M066). This honors ADR-017 (deferral) while making future activation a strategy swap, not a rewrite.
latest.decision: How M103 S02 pipeline framework (pipeline/ package) accounts for queues and future scheduling/agent planning without violating ADR-017 (queue deferred) and ADR-027 (phased scheduler)

Принять гексагональную (Ports/Adapters) + луковичную (domain/application/infrastructure) архитектуру как целевую структуру research_graph/. Ports реализуются как typing.Protocol в domain/; Adapters в infrastructure/. Port добавляется ТОЛЬКО при ≥2 реализациях, запланированной миграции, или требовании к mockability (Ponytail override — не для симметрии). Ввести Ponytail как кодовую дисциплину (skill в .agents/skills/ponytail/, правила в AGENTS.md) с §6.3 инвариантами как NEVER-списком.
latest.when: Пересматривается при добавлении 3+ доменов (Phase 5), миграции на распределённую очередь, или если sync-оркестрация станет узким местом на масштабе >10k статей.

latest.choice: Отказ от Prefect, оставить EP-4 DispatchProtocol seam
latest.decision: НЕ вводить Prefect как Central Flow Orchestrator. S02 уже планирует DispatchProtocol/SyncDispatch/QueueDispatch поверх UniversalKBQueue — это покрывает Phase 2 (sync) и Phase 4 (queue activation). EP-4 (DispatchProtocol) оставляет дверь открытой: если sync-режим станет узким местом на Phase 4, Prefect добавляется как PrefectDispatch Adapter без переписывания Core. Ресурс-планировщик усиливается своими силами (~150 строк поверх UniversalKBQueue), не как отдельный сервис/фреймворк.
latest.when: Пересматривается на Phase 4 (queue activation + real concurrency), если profiling покажет что sync-оркестрация тормозит при >100 параллельных статей, или если понадобится dynamic branching/Prefect UI для operational observability.

latest.choice: FullTextProviderPort за MDConverter вместо PDFParserPort (M104 S02 pivot)
latest.decision: Перепланировать M104 S02: вместо преждевременного PDFParserPort (S01) ввести FullTextProviderPort для MDConverter. Разведка показала: parse_article — одна детерминированная реализация (markdown headings), 4 'движка' (Marker/GROBID/arxiv2md/OpenDataLoader) — external offline producers (manifest-driven ADR-013), не runtime. Реальный runtime seam с ≥2 backends и fallback routing — MDConverter (corpus/sources/markdown_converter.py): convert(arxiv_id)->ConversionResult с backends arxiv2md/marker/docling + _needs_marker_fallback fallback логикой. Удалить PDFParserPort из domain/ports.py (одна реализация parse_article — Ponytail Port rule не оправдан: нет ≥2 runtime реализаций и нет миграции). FullTextProviderPort = convert/convert_sync signatures, MDConverter удовлетворяет структурно. parse_article и build_page_index НЕ трогать (deterministic, одна реализация — Port не нужен).
latest.when: Пересматривается если появится 2-я runtime реализация parse_article (например, structured PDF parser vs markdown parser), или если MDConverter backends изменятся.

titles.R014: Local full-text ingestion must produce deterministic, provenance-rich ingestion results for markdown and plain-text paper artifacts.
titles.R015: PageIndex document navigation must represent fixture papers as deterministic PageIndexNode hierarchies with parent, child, NEXT, path, and validation diagnostics.
titles.R016: SemanticChunk records and EvidencePath objects must provide deterministic traceability from Paper to PageIndexNode to chunk.
titles.R017: Claim, ScientificEntity, and ScientificRelation contracts must reference EvidencePath records or explicit validation errors.
titles.R018: LadybugDB SCI KG schema must store Paper, PageIndexNode, SemanticChunk, Claim, ScientificEntity, ScientificRelation, EvidencePath, and required edges idempotently and transaction-safely.
titles.R019: Hybrid retrieval must return traceable evidence contexts with vector, graph, fusion score metadata, and EvidencePath references.
titles.R020: Evaluation fixtures and metrics must exist before scale, optimizer, DSPy, RLM, or retrieval-quality claims are made.
titles.R021: DSPy extraction boundaries must remain disabled or non-optimizing until evaluation metrics and benchmark fixtures are verified.
titles.R022: RLM document navigation and workflow-in-code prototypes must be read-only, bounded, and return typed draft outputs plus trajectories validated by deterministic code.
titles.R023: RLM graph traversal must be benchmarked against vector-only, one-hop graph expansion, and heuristic BFS before adoption recommendations are made.
titles.R024: Before expanding beyond M003, the system must validate current scientific KG behavior on staged real article batches of 10 documents, 20 documents, and then a one-week corpus, with analysis of graph quality at each stage.
titles.R025: Full-text acquisition and real-corpus KG validation must emit structured Loguru-based logs and persisted diagnostics for each selected paper before rerunning the 10-document validation.
titles.R026: Before scaling validation to 10, 20, or larger document batches, the real-data scientific KG pipeline must be debugged end-to-end on the current small corpus through full text, PageIndex, SemanticChunk, EvidencePath, ExtractionPatch, SCI KG persistence, and retrieval diagnostics.
titles.R027: Before scientific KG validation or scaling continues, converted paper data and chunks must satisfy an explicit graph-readiness quality contract covering conversion fidelity, normalization, chunk semantics, table/figure handling, section hierarchy, and evidence provenance.
titles.R028: Validation of conversion, chunking, extraction, and graph-readiness must include an independent artifact review step where feasible, preferably via a subagent, that inspects raw outputs and test meaningfulness rather than relying only on code tests or mocked fixtures.
titles.R029: Before KG import continues, chunking must produce an import-ready typed chunk package with stable IDs, source spans, parent-child lineage, content routes, quality states, deterministic annotations, and independent review evidence.
titles.R030: Article ingestion must preserve source artifacts alongside derived text, including the original PDF, normalized Markdown, extracted figures, tables, image assets, hashes, provenance, and redacted asset manifests for future multimodal retrieval.
titles.R031: Before drawing broader chunking/import-readiness conclusions, validation must expand from the 10-paper gold corpus to a 30-paper deviation scan that compares distributions, outliers, missing-source rates, route/refusal patterns, and new failure modes without authorizing production KG import.
titles.R032: Corpus validation must support an automated +10-paper iterative loop up to 100 papers, with resumable batch state, source acquisition, deviation analysis, remediation recommendations, and strict no-import/no-write safety gates.
titles.R033: Provide a deterministic, resumable CLI workflow for iterative +10-paper validation batches toward a 100-paper diagnostic corpus.
titles.R034: Run the first genuinely new +10-paper validation batch through the deterministic M007 validation-batch workflow.
titles.R035: Validation batches must fill the target accepted-paper quota by drawing deterministic replacement candidates when selected papers cannot become source-ready within bounded acquisition rules.
titles.R036: Validation CLI runs must produce replay/audit provenance logs tying each generated artifact to the exact command, inputs, output hashes, exit code, cwd, git commit, and active milestone/batch context.
titles.R037: Run the next reviewed +10 validation batch using M009 runbook gates: active scan lineage, real provenance entry, artifact freshness verification, and bounded top-up handling before scan.
titles.R038: Before any positive KG import, a reviewed semantic evidence gate must evaluate a small subset of scanned chunks/outliers for factual extraction readiness without writing to production LadybugDB.
titles.R039: Before enabling DSPy or MiniMax in the Scientific KG pipeline, the project must complete parallel compatibility research proving version/API requirements, minimal invocation paths, failure modes, artifact boundaries, and no-import/no-write safety constraints.
titles.R040: New infrastructure must be researched, compatibility-probed, and safety-wrapped before it is enabled in the main Scientific KG process.
titles.R041: Before any DSPy optimizer or MiniMax helper is used in the Scientific KG process, the project must prove detailed optimizer applicability, dependency/install feasibility, bounded invocation, and explicit blocked/allowed scopes.
titles.R042: MiniMax advancement must use real bounded API tests, document Token Plan quota/limit visibility, and keep external calls redacted and non-authoritative.
titles.R043: MiniMax remediation must prove Token Plan limit-check access and structured JSON behavior using the correct API surfaces before any helper verdict is accepted.
titles.R044: MiniMax limit checking must follow the 9router endpoint/fallback/parsing algorithm before declaring Token Plan remains unresolved.
titles.R045: MiniMax helper implementation must turn the verified MiniMax findings into dev-only, tested code before MiniMax is used in any Scientific KG workflow.
titles.R046: Triage ML dependency vulnerabilities before enabling any runtime path that uses vulnerable ML packages.
titles.R047: Compare selected open-source research-agent systems before adopting any research-agent patterns into the Scientific KG workflow.
titles.R048: Define and validate KG candidate locators with chunk-span provenance before any positive Scientific KG import is allowed.
titles.R049: Implement deterministic candidate locator generation with schema validation, source hash checks, coordinate validation, safety guards, and ambiguity diagnostics while keeping KG import disabled.
titles.R050: Provide a deterministic CLI for detecting article structure artifacts and candidate KG scaffold links from preserved paper sources without performing KG import.
titles.R051: MiniMax may assist article artifact detection only as a bounded structured helper with forced tool calls, local schema validation, redacted inputs, and non-authoritative outputs.
titles.R052: DSPy prompt optimization for artifact detection must remain gated until benchmark fixtures, metrics, and baseline MiniMax or deterministic outputs exist.
titles.R053: External PDF/parser tool evaluation must compare current daily-archive outputs with opendataloader-pdf and GROBID on a bounded local PDF corpus before any parser integration or graph-readiness claim is accepted.
titles.R054: Provide a durable lazy async sidecar pipeline for article processing jobs.
titles.R055: Track sidecar job lifecycle, retries, typed blockers, and backend/cache health explicitly.
titles.R056: Parser sidecar outputs must remain candidate evidence until daily-archive validators, review packets, and graph-readiness review pass.
titles.R057: Future sidecar-pipeline roadmap must include explicit architecture brainstorm and decision gates at key irreversible points.
titles.R058: Post-M033 ADR package must root every sidecar and orchestration decision in the overall daily-archive mission: local-first scientific paper evidence chains before any Scientific KG or LadybugDB import.
titles.R059: Do not lock the future knowledge graph database choice to LadybugDB before a dedicated GraphDB evaluation compares viable local-first candidates.
titles.R060: Frame the architecture around a universal local-first knowledge base, with scientific articles as the primary current domain and proving ground.
titles.R061: M034 must audit all existing GSD requirements and decisions for mutual consistency with the universal knowledge-base ADR package before closeout.
titles.R062: Governance memory must provide a fast codebase-memory ADR/R/D mirror generated from canonical GSD and ADR artifacts without becoming the source of truth.
titles.R063: Governance memory must expose a typed ADR/R/D graph projection with verifiable nodes and edges while preserving GSD and ADR files as canonical.
titles.R064: The real-corpus no-write smoke must support a mixed 20-30 article batch containing retained baseline articles, fresh articles, and reference-linked candidates when safely discoverable.
titles.R065: Provide a unified project trajectory check that summarizes architecture decisions, requirements, module/code movement, evidence maturity, safety boundaries, and next blockers so agents can detect drift before planning or execution.
titles.R066: Extract LLM access into a dedicated architecture module that supports MiniMax, GLM/Z.ai, and optional future Headroom routing/compression scenarios.
titles.R067: The system must implement a 7-layer typed knowledge pipeline (Source → Parser → Structure → Extraction → Graph → Review → Agents) per ADR-023. Each layer must produce durable, traceable artifacts with stable IDs and evidence provenance.
titles.R068: Every LLM extraction stage must be preceded by deterministic/statistical pre-processing (YAKE keywords, TF-IDF summaries, graph community detection, embedding similarity). The LLM receives both raw text AND statistical context per ADR-024.
titles.R069: The LLM module must support multiple providers (MiniMax primary, GLM secondary) with per-provider rate limit checking before API calls, automatic fallback on rate exhaustion, and durable usage tracking per provider in the queue per ADR-025.
titles.R070: Future agents must use FSM-controlled reasoning inspired by SymFSM: LLM acts as interpreter within a pre-built reasoning model (cognitive map from FalkorDB subgraph), not as free-form generator. Every agent action passes through fail-closed safety gates per ADR-026.
titles.R071: The system must support typed knowledge schema with 5 entity modules (A: factual/meta, B: textually mentioned, C: implicit/abstracted, D: citation relationships, E: knowledge relations) adapted from Agents-K1, with ~25 typed relation types in 5 groups (controlled, causal, composition, comparison, citation).
titles.R072: The pipeline queue scheduler must coordinate job dispatch across three resource dimensions: LLM API rate limits (per-provider token/time quotas), CPU/local compute (parser/heavy processing concurrency), and I/O (network fetch, disk write, graph write serialization). Jobs are routed to the least-constrained resource lane with automatic backoff and recovery per ADR-027.
